## Summary

The locality derivation now prefers the postcode, falling back to the city table.

**`LocalityLookup.java`** — added a two-arg `regionFor(city, postcode)`:
- `regionForPostcode` maps a 4-digit postcode to its region via the range table (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099), returning `null` when the postcode is absent, non-4-digit, or in no known range.
- When the postcode resolves a region it wins; otherwise it falls back to the existing city-to-region lookup. The original single-arg `regionFor(city)` is retained (still used by `ValidateOwnerPostcode`).

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — the `locality` mapping expression now passes both `owner.getCity()` and `owner.getPostcode()`.

This returns the same region for known cities (e.g. Sydney @ 2000 → NSW) but disambiguates same-named cities via postcode — a VIC-range postcode (3000) on an otherwise-unknown city now yields VIC, exactly as the new acceptance tests assert.
